prompts:
You are one drone in a search team. Your own sector is already finished.
Choose your next step. You may ONLY pick one of the tools below.

SITUATION
- last_event: skill_succeeded
- battery_remaining: 96%
- role: scout
- listen_rounds_used: 1 of 3
- actions_used: 0 of 8
- own_targets: 0
- second_hand_targets: 2
TEAMMATES
  Drone1: last heard 0s ago, last at (-1, -1)
  Drone2: last heard 0s ago, last at (1, 20)
  Drone4: last heard 0s ago, last at (-21, 39)
TASKS (as you currently see them)
- search_A (sector A): complete by Drone2
- search_B (sector B): complete by Drone4
- search_C (sector C): complete by Drone3
- search_D (sector D): complete by Drone1
MAP (world meters)
- you are at (39, -21)
- sector A: x 20..40, y 20..40
- sector B: x -40..-20, y 20..40
- sector C: x 20..40, y -40..-20
- sector D: x -40..-20, y -40..-20
OPTIONS
- return_home: stop and fly home to land.
- hold: stay here a few more seconds in case a teammate is about to report.
- act_as_relay: become a relay: hold station and keep reporting in (does not route traffic for others).
- go_to_waypoint: fly to world position (x, y) in meters at your current altitude, e.g. to look somewhere new. Parameters: "x" and "y" numbers.
- request_help: ask teammates for help (informational; never an order). Name the teammates in this tool's own "recipients" parameter and leave outgoing_messages empty - the tool itself sends the request. Parameters: "recipients" a list from ['Drone1', 'Drone2', 'Drone4'].
- change_role: change your role: scout (searches), relay (holds station) or reserve (spare). Parameters: "new_role" one of ['relay', 'reserve'].

Reply with ONLY a JSON object of exactly this shape:
{"situation_assessment": {"mission_progress": "<none|partial|complete>", "communication_status": "<good|degraded|lost>", "current_risk": "<low|medium|high>"}, "selected_tool": "<option>", "parameters": {"reason_code": "<code>"}, "outgoing_messages": [], "confidence": <number from 0 to 1>}
parameters must also contain whatever parameters the chosen option lists, and nothing else.
For go_to_waypoint, for example: {"reason_code": "<code>", "x": <number>, "y": <number>}
reason_code must be one of: waiting_for_report, nothing_more_to_wait_for, teammate_may_need_help, battery_conserving, my_work_is_done, search_elsewhere
outgoing_messages is [] unless you want to ask teammates for help; then each message is {"message_type": "help_request", "recipients": ["<teammate name from TEAMMATES>"], "payload": {"reason_code": "<code>"}} (at most 4, help_request is the only type allowed)
